==Quest Start==
'''Note:''' For the older versions of the rewards for these quest (prior to the 7/24/11 patch) see [[Plane of Sky Quests (Old)]].

Talk to Enchanter Jolas in the [[Plane of Sky]].

You say, 'hail Enchanter Jolas'
:''Enchanter Jolas says 'Greetings.  Have you come here to test your powers of enchantment? ''
You say, 'I have come here to test my powers of enchantment'
:''Enchanter Jolas says 'I am most honored to be able to help you.  Please choose from one of my instructors, Lelulean or Enderbite.''

= Lelulean =

You say, 'I choose Lelulean'
:''Enchanter Jolas says 'Lelulean it shall be.  Take this book and read it.  When you are finished, hand it back to me and I shall summon Enchantress Lelulean to test you. ''
:''Enchanter Jolas says 'Farewell. ''
:''Lelulean says 'I am here to do your bidding, Enchanter Spirit! '
:''Enchanter Jolas says 'Till next time!  Farewell! ''
You say, 'hail Lelulean'
:''Lelulean says 'Welcome.  I am Enchantress Lelulean.  Do you wish to test your powers? ''
You say, 'I wish to test my powers'
:''Lelulean says 'Great, let us waste no more time!  I have three tests from which you can choose.  They are illusion, metamorphism, and deception. ''

{{CheckboxList}}

== Enchanter Test of Illusion ==

Lelulean says 'Illusion it is.  Proceed upward through the sky and return to me a crimson tessera, a darkstone emerald, and a finely woven cloth cord.  This will prove your abilities to me and I will reward you with a cord of sphinx hair.

'''Reward:''' {{:Sphinx Hair Cord}}
<ul>
  <li>{{:Crimson Tessera}} ([[a thunder spirit]] - Island 1)'''
  <li>{{:Darkstone Emerald}} ([[Protector of Sky]] - Island 2 Boss)
  <li><span style="font-weight: bold">{{:Finely Woven Cloth Cord}}</span> ([[Gorgalosk]] - Island 3 Boss)
</ul>


== Enchanter Test of Metamorphism ==

Lelulean says 'Metamorphism it is.  Proceed upward through the sky and return to me a silver disk, a bluish stone, and a light cloth mantle.  This will prove your abilities to me and I will reward you with the Wind Walker's Mantle. 

'''Reward:''' {{:Wind Walker's Mantle}}
<ul>
  <li>{{:Silver Disc}} ([[an azarack]] - Island 2)
  <li>{{:Bluish Stone}} ([[a gorgalask]], [[a watchful guard]], [[a spirited harpie]], [[an avenging gazer]] - Island 3)
  <li><span style="font-weight: bold">{{:Light Cloth Mantle}}</span> ([[Keeper of Souls]] - Island 4 Boss)
</ul>


== Enchanter Test of Deception ==

Lelulean says 'Deception it is.  Proceed upward through the sky and return to me a rugous globe, a sky pearl, and a silken mask.  This will prove your abilities to me and I will reward you with an ivory mask. 

'''Reward:''' {{:Ivory Mask}}
<ul>
  <li>{{:Rugous Globe}} ([[a crystalline cloud]], [[a shimmering meteor]], [[a gust of wind]] - Island 3)
  <li>{{:Sky Pearl}} ([[a soul carrier]], [[an essence carrier]], [[a soul tamer]], [[an essence tamer]] - Island 4)
  <li><span style="font-weight: bold">{{:Silken Mask}}</span> ([[The Spiroc Lord]] - Island 5 Boss)
</ul>


= Enderbite =

You say, 'I choose enderbite'
:''Enchanter Jolas says 'Enderbite it shall be.  Take this book and read it.  When you are finished, hand it back to me and I shall summon Enchantress Enderbite to test you. ''
:''Enchanter Jolas says 'Farewell. ''
:''Enderbite says 'I am here to do your bidding, Enchanter Spirit! ''
:''Enchanter Jolas says 'Till next time!  Farewell! ''
You say, 'hail Enderbite'
:''Enderbite says 'Welcome.  I am Enchantress Enderbite.  Do you wish to test your powers? Or have you come to trade back an old item. ''
You say, 'I wish to trade back an old item'
:''Enderbite says 'I have decided that the Rod of Warding Winds is not fitting for a person of your significance.  Bring me one of these rods and I will replace it with something that will suit you a tad more. ''
You say, 'I wish to test my powers'
:''Enderbite says 'Great, let us waste no more time!  I have three tests from which you may choose.  They are disillusion, memorization, and incapacitation. ''

== Enchanter Test of Memorization ==

Enderbite says 'Memorization it is.  Proceed upward through the sky and return to me a carmine spiroc feather, some ganoric poison, and a glowing necklace.  This will prove your abilities to me and I will reward you with a Necklace of Whispering Winds. 

'''Reward:''' {{:Necklace of Whispering Winds}}
<ul>
  <li>{{:Carmine Spiroc Feather}} ([[a spiroc arbiter]], [[a spiroc banisher]], [[a spiroc caller]] - Island 5)
  <li>{{:Ganoric Poison}} ([[Bazzzazzt]], [[Bzzzt]], [[Bazzt Zzzt]] - Island 6)
  <li><span style="font-weight: bold">{{:Glowing Necklace}}</span> ([[Sister of the Spire]] - Island 7)
</ul>

== Enchanter Test of Disillusion ==

Enderbite says 'Disillusion it is.  Proceed upward through the sky and return to me a harpy statuette, a nebulous sapphire, and an adamantium earring.  This will prove your abilities to me and I will reward you with an Earring of Displacement. 

'''Reward:''' {{:Earring of Displacement}}
<ul>
  <li>{{:Harpy Statuette}} ([[a soul harvester]], [[an essence harvester]] - Island 4)
  <li>{{:Black Nebulous Sapphire}} ([[The Spiroc Guardian]], [[a spiroc walker]] - Island 5)
  <li><span style="font-weight: bold">{{:Adamantium Earring}}</span> ([[Bazzt Zzzt]] - Island 6)
</ul>


== Enchanter Test of Incapacitation ==

Enderbite says 'Incapacitation it is.  Proceed upward through the sky and return to me an efreeti wind staff, some sweet nectar, a black sky diamond, and a large sky sapphire.  This will prove your abilities to me and I will reward you with the Staff of Warding Winds. 

'''Reward:''' {{:Rod of the Protecting Winds}}
<ul>
  <li>{{:Sweet Nectar}} ([[bzzazzt]] - Island 6)
  <li>{{:Black Sky Diamond}} ([[a fatestealer drake]], [[heartsbane drake]], [[a windrider drake]], [[a greater sphinx]], [[undine spirit]] - Island 7)
  <li>{{:Large Sky Sapphire (Enchanter)}} ([[Eye of Veeshan]] - Island 8)
  <li><span style="font-weight: bold">{{:Efreeti Wind Staff}}</span> ([[Noble Dojorn]], [[Overseer of Air]], [[the Hand of Veeshan]] - Islands 1.5, 4, 8)
</ul>
